value.rationale: Addresses a canonical primitive companion initial-value branch of Shapiro Open Questions 27 (2023) with a natural exact classification of all parameter pairs. Distinguishes binomid from mere index-divisibility arguments and supplies a complete affirmative case of the binomid-implies-divisible problem. Finite obstructions are substantive as they collapse an infinite two-parameter family.
